cards.proposal: Discuss Amivantamab + carboplatin + pemetrexed as the leading option; Carboplatin + pemetrexed or Clinical trial of a fourth-generation EGFR inhibitor active against C797S as alternatives.
why: L858R is the sensitising driver. C797S removes the cysteine that osimertinib binds covalently, a known on-target resistance mechanism.
Setting: Second line after a third-generation EGFR inhibitor.
1. Amivantamab + carboplatin + pemetrexed: FDA approval Sep 2024 after osimertinib progression (MARIPOSA-2).
2. Carboplatin + pemetrexed: Platinum doublet is the standard chemotherapy backbone after EGFR TKI failure.
3. Clinical trial of a fourth-generation EGFR inhibitor active against C797S: No approved C797S-directed drug; several agents in phase 1–3 trials (e.g. BH-30643 ORR 45% in 40 patients, 2026).
cards.confidenceReason: Options come from the curated knowledge pack; the current NCCN/ESMO version must be checked.
cards.uncertain: Drug availability, cost and the patient's preferences are not in the record.
alternatives: Clinical trial of a fourth-generation EGFR inhibitor active against C797S
cards.changesIf: Continuing osimertinib alone is not advised: Radiological progression with an on-target resistance mutation. First- or second-generation EGFR inhibitor without testing T790M status is not advised: Activity against C797S depends on whether T790M is in cis or trans; not established here.

boardSummary: Woman in her 50s, never-smoker, stage IVB EGFR L858R lung adenocarcinoma (TP53 R273H co-mutation, PD-L1 TPS 10%), ECOG 1. First-line osimertinib gave a partial response. ctDNA re-emerged in 2026-09, then RECIST 1.1 progression on 2026-11-16 (45 mm vs 32 mm nadir, new 1.4 cm liver lesion). Plasma NGS shows EGFR C797S (VAF 1.2%) and no MET amplification. Plasma can miss MET amplification and cannot exclude small-cell transformation, so a liver re-biopsy is suggested before committing to a regimen. The knowledge pack lists amivantamab plus carboplatin-pemetrexed as preferred after osimertinib. Alternatives are carboplatin-pemetrexed or a C797S-directed trial. QT safety needs review: the medication list still shows osimertinib and citalopram. No brain imaging since baseline is documented. Doses come only from the dose calculator, pending pharmacist verification.
